about: Response shape of the Blue Intelligence routes NAVIGUIDE (naviguide.fr) calls, with the query parameters its code sends, recorded on the production branch with the seeded offline harness (tests/contracts/naviguide_harness.py; app.main.app with ADMIN_KEY set as in production). A recorded key or feature property must not be removed, renamed or change JSON type, and the status must not change; new keys are allowed.
types: string | number | boolean | null | object | array
